title: claude-broker namespace manifest
description: Declares one namespace on top of the server-owned base protocol (schemas/base/*.json): who its workers are, which channels exist, which message types each channel accepts, and how the namespace narrows or extends the base types. Replaces the per-namespace copies of setup-schemas-<ns>.js and schemas/<ns>-*.json for namespaces that opt in.

ns.description: Namespace prefix without the dash, e.g. 'cb'. Channels are '<ns>-<name>'.

version.description: Base protocol version this manifest targets.

strict.description: Namespace default enforcement: false = warn-only, true = reject. Per-channel 'strict' overrides. Flips need orchestrator authorization.

closed.description: Namespace default: reject fields not declared by base, extension or the common envelope. Per-channel and per-type 'closed' override.

roles.description: Role-level extensions, applied when the envelope's 'from' is a worker with that role (workers[].role). summary_prefixes is the one place a manifest may widen base: base result.summary is a pattern (PASS|FAIL|SKIP) that ANDed fragments cannot widen, so the loader rebuilds the pattern from base + the sender role's list (cb-notes #168904). extensions are ANDed for senders with that role.

summary_prefixes.description: Extra result summary prefixes accepted besides PASS/FAIL/SKIP, e.g. APPROVE, ADVISE, BLOCK.

workers.description: Sessions in this namespace. Drives inbox routing, capability registration and role-scoped tool lists.

role.description: Selects the tool list and which channels the worker may write.

mode.description: "hold" = hold-only (e.g. a judge that never answers): the broker lets this sender write only type:judgment with verdict "held" on <ns>-notes, type:status on <ns>-status, and <ns>-telemetry / <ns>-rate-limits, and refuses every other write (lib/messages.js holdRefusal). Absent = no restriction.

kind.description: Role of the channel; the server derives retention (backlog/notes are prune-exempt), sender rules and defaults from it.

types.description: Message types accepted: base types and/or local_types names.

additionalProperties.description: Tightens a base type (or defines a namespace-local type) for this namespace. Every fragment is ANDed with schemas/base/<type>.json, so an extension can only narrow, never widen.

properties.description: JSON Schema fragments per field, ANDed with the base definition (e.g. a task_id pattern, a maxLength, an enum, a nested required list).

fields.description: Exact allow-list of top-level fields; implies closed and replaces the base/extension property union. For types that share an envelope but must not carry the base type's optional fields.

closed.description: Overrides the channel/namespace 'closed': true rejects fields not declared by base, the extension or common envelope fields.

allOf.description: Conditional rules (if/then) applied after the type is selected, e.g. 'sprint-start requires sprint_id'.

extensions.description: Per-channel overrides, merged over the namespace-level extensions for the same type.

local_types.description: Namespace-local message types with no base schema (e.g. 'rotate', 'sprint-start'). Unless envelope:false, the common envelope — type, task_id, from, to, subject, optional body/refs — is implied and the entry adds to it.

envelope.description: false = do not imply the common envelope (retrospective-style free-form records); then required must list everything.

extensions.description: Namespace-wide per-type extensions. Keys are base types (task, result, status, question, finding, decision, resolved, heartbeat, deferred, deferred-resolved, approval-token) or local_types names. Key 'deferred' covers both deferred and deferred-resolved (one base file).
